name: Bear Mage
description: Bear Mage, created for the CRO-MAGNON multiplayer game using an AI-generated reference image and local TRELLIS-2 image-to-3D reconstruction, followed by mesh refinement. Rigged and animated; includes 9 animation clips: Attack, Craft, Eat, Gather, Give, Idle_Loop, Run_Loop, Walk_Loop, Wave. Original game GLB with embedded materials and textures.
